oscar.jpg.file: File:Oscar, cat from the German ship 'Bismarck'.jpg

bismarck-fjord.jpg.file: File:German Battleship Bismarck in the Grimstadfjord.jpg
bismarck-fjord.jpg.description: Bismarck in a Norwegian fjord, 21 May 1941, shortly before departing for her Atlantic sortie. Photographed from the heavy cruiser Prinz Eugen. Location is probably Grimstadfjord, just south of Bergen.

bismarck-sinking.jpg.artist: Lt. J.H. Smith, Royal Navy official photographer.
bismarck-sinking.jpg.description: The German battleship Bismarck on fire in the distance, surrounded by shell splashes. The photo was taken from one of the Royal Navy warships chasing.

bismarck-burning.jpg.file: File:Battleship Bismarck under fire and burning 1941.jpg
bismarck-burning.jpg.artist: Lt. J.H. Smith, Royal Navy official photographer
bismarck-burning.jpg.description: The sinking German battleship Bismarck on fire in the distance, surrounded by shell splashes. The photo was taken from one of the Royal Navy warships chasing.

bismarck-survivors.jpg.description: Survivors from the Bismarck are pulled aboard HMS Dorsetshire (40) on 27 May 1941.

cossack.jpg.description: The Tribal class destroyer HMS Cossack (F03) underway on completion.

cossack-towed.jpg.description: Royal Navy C class destroyer HMS Cossack (R57) under tow

arkroyal-sink.jpg.file: File:The Sinking of HMS Ark Royal. 13 November 1941 A6327.jpg
arkroyal-sink.jpg.description: The Sinking of HMS Ark Royal. 13 November 1941 View from HMS HERMIONE showing HMS ARK ROYAL after being hit by a torpedo, listing to starboard, while HMS LAFOREY closes the carrier.

arkroyal-sink2.jpg.artist: Beadell, S J (Lt) Royal Navy official photographer
arkroyal-sink2.jpg.description: IWM caption : HMS LEGION moves alongside the damaged and listing HMS ARK ROYAL in order to take off survivors. The aircraft carrier was torpedoed by the German U-boat U 81 off Gibraltar. HMS ARK ROYAL sank the following day.
